title: Hold a commercial fishing licence
what: Take fish for trade or commerce only while holding, or acting under, an authority that allows it (the Fisheries (General) Regulation 2019 prescribes the act).

sources.title: Fisheries Act 1994 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not unlawfully do an act prescribed by regulation or declared by a declaration as an act that must only be done by the holder of an authority

sources.title: Fisheries (General) Regulation 2019 (Qld)
sources.quote: Prescribed act taking fish for trade or commerce Who has authority to do prescribed act a person who holds, or is acting under, an authority authorising the person to take the fish for trade or commerce

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Fisheries Act 1994 (Qld)
